```{r import data}
# case data
measles_data_imp <- read.csv(here("data/measles_data.csv")
)

measles_data <- measles_data_imp %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(1:2, 6, 7, 9, 10, 18:20, 23, 25, 30, 32, 38, 40, 41, 42, 53, 58, 59, 69, 70, 73, 73,  90, 98:103)) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = if_else(
      camp == "other",
      specify_other_camp,
      camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-specify_other_camp) %>% 
  mutate(
    block = str_remove(block, "^block_"),
    camp = str_replace(camp, "^camp_", "Camp ")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = if_else(
      camp == "KTP Register Camp", "Kutupalong RC",
      camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    camp = case_when(
      camp %in% c("Camp 1", "Camp 8") ~ paste0(camp, "E"),
      TRUE ~ camp
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    date_of_visit = as.Date(date_of_visit, format = "%d/%m/%Y")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(block = stringr::str_to_sentence(block))

measles_data <- measles_data %>% 
  mutate(ipd_opd = case_when(patient_id == "n/a" ~ "OPD",
                             TRUE ~ "IPD"))

#map data
sub_blocks <- st_read(here("data/Block_Boundary_V1/Block_Boundary_V1.shp"), quiet = TRUE) %>% 
  filter(!CampName_1 %in% c("Camp 21", "Camp 22", "Camp 24", "Camp 25", "Camp 26", "Camp 27", "Nayapara RC")) %>% 
  mutate(CampName_1 = str_remove(CampName_1, " Extension$"))

#merge datasets
cases_sf <- measles_data %>%
  left_join(
    sub_blocks,
    by = c("camp" = "CampName_1",
           "block" = "BlockLabel"
           )
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# points for map
cases_points <- cases_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(District)) %>% 
  mutate(
    geometry = map(
      geometry,
      ~ st_sample(.x, size = 1) %>% st_cast("POINT")
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(geometry) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_set_crs(st_crs(sub_blocks))

camp_boundaries <- sub_blocks %>%
  group_by(CampName_1) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

epi_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_of_visit)) %>% 
  arrange(date_of_visit) %>%
  group_by(date_of_visit) %>%
  mutate(
    case_id = row_number(),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Sex: ", gender, "<br>",
      "Age: ", age_in_years, " years<br>"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r calculate numbers}
# Total cases
total_cases <- nrow(measles_data)

# Severe cases
severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Simple cases
simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly cases (last 7 days)
weekly_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7) %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly severe cases
weekly_severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7,
         ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Weekly simple cases
weekly_simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit >= Sys.Date() - 7,
         ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's cases
yesterdays_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1) %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's severe cases
yesterdays_severe_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1,
         ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

# Yesterday's simple cases
yesterdays_simple_cases <- measles_data %>%
  filter(date_of_visit == Sys.Date() - 1,
         ipd_opd == "OPD") %>%
  nrow()
```

```{r}
vaccinated <- measles_data %>%

    final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition = sum (final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
total = n())

N_OPD <- measles_data %>%
  filter(
    patient_id == "n/a"
  ) %>%
  nrow()
#number of IPD
N_IPD <- measles_data %>%
  filter(patient_id != "n/a") %>%
```

# Indicators 
```{r indicators}
# Start and end date of surveillance and total days surveilled
surv_start <- min(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_end   <- max(measles_data$date_of_visit, na.rm = TRUE)
surv_days  <- as.integer(difftime(surv_end, surv_start, units = "days")) + 1

# total number of Cases 
N_total <- nrow(measles_data)
N_cases_u5 <- measles_data %>% 
  filter(age_in_years < 5) %>% 
  nrow()
# number of OPD cases(includes NAs)

#Number of discharged, LAMA as outcome (IPD)
N_discharge <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "discharged", na.rm = TRUE)
N_LAMA      <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "lama", na.rm = TRUE)


pct_discharge <- round(N_discharge / N_total * 100, 1)
pct_LAMA      <- round(N_LAMA / N_total * 100, 1)

# camp of origin (all cases)
N_JMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "new_jms") %>%
  nrow()

N_HMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "hms") %>%
  nrow()
O_JMS <- measles_data %>%
  filter(phc == "old_jms") %>%
  nrow()

#Total Population (at risk) = FDMN All camp <5 year age
pop_at_risk <- 184858

# Overall Attack Rate (/1,000) 
#1st calculate cases amongst population at risk (FDMN)
N_total_fdmn <- measles_data %>%
  filter(nationality == "fdmn") %>%
  nrow()
#2nd calculate attack rate
attack_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 1000, 2)
#Overall Incidence Rate (/10k/day)
incidence_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 10000 / surv_days, 3)

# Severe cases (N and %), 
N_severe <- sum(measles_data$clinical_severity == "severe", na.rm = TRUE)
severe_rate <- round(N_severe / N_total * 100, 2)

# deaths and mortality rate (total and in under 5)
N_deaths    <- sum(measles_data$outcome == "died", na.rm = TRUE)
#Case fatality
cfr <- round(N_deaths / N_total * 100, 2)
deaths_u5 <- measles_data %>%
  filter(outcome == "died", age_in_years < 5) %>%
  nrow()
cfr_u5 <- round(deaths_u5 / N_cases_u5 * 100, 2)

#Vaccination 
N_vaccinated <- sum(measles_data$did_the_patient_receive_measle == "yes", na.rm = TRUE)
vacc_coverage <- round(N_vaccinated / N_total * 100, 1)

#nationality of patients (N and %)
fdmn <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "fdmn", na.rm = TRUE)
host <- sum(measles_data$nationality == "host", na.rm = TRUE)

fdmn_pct <- round(fdmn / N_total * 100, 2)
host_pct <- round(host / N_total * 100, 2)

#pneumonia amongst ipd 
ipd <- measles_data %>% filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes")
pneumonia_ipd <- sum(
  ipd$pneumonia == TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
pct_pneumonia_ipd <- round(pneumonia_ipd / N_IPD * 100, 1)

#Complications in IPD
complications_ipd <- ipd %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("complications_")) %>%
  mutate(across(
    everything(),
    ~ .x %in% c(TRUE, "TRUE", "true")
  ))

complication_prop <- complications_ipd %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "complication",
    values_to = "n"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    complication = str_remove(complication, "^complications_"),
    pct = round(n / N_IPD * 100, 1)
  )

complication_text <- complication_prop %>%
  mutate(
    txt = paste0(
      str_to_title(complication),
      ": ",
      pct,
      "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(txt) %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")

DENOMINATOR <- N_total

OPD_pct <-round(N_OPD / N_total * 100, 2)
IPD_pct <-round(N_IPD / N_total * 100, 2)
```

```{r second indicator table}
#| title: "Surveillance"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define indicator labels (ASCII-safe, fixed length = 22)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

indicators <- c(
  "Discharged - N (%)",
  "LAMA - N (%)",
  "Died - N (%)",

  "New JMS cases",
  "Old JMS cases",
  "HMS cases",

  "Overall attack rate (/1,000)",
  "Overall incidence rate (/10,000 pop-day)",

  "Deaths - N (overall)",
  "Case fatality rate - overall (%)",

  "Deaths <5 years - N",
  "Case fatality rate - <5 years (%)",

  "Vaccinated - N",
  "Vaccination coverage (%)",

  "Unvaccinated - N (%)",

  "FDMN (Rohingya) - N (%)",
  "Host (Bangladeshi) - N (%)",

  "SAM - N (<5y, MUAC <11.5 cm)",
  "MAM - N (<5y, MUAC 11.5-12.4)"
)


add_section <- function(title) {
  tibble(
    Indicator    = title,
    N    = NA,
    Denominator  = NA,
    `Rate / %`   = NA
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build the surveillance overview table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

surveillance_overview <- tibble(
  Indicator = indicators,
  N = c(
    N_discharge,
    N_LAMA,
    N_deaths,

    N_JMS,
    O_JMS,
    N_HMS,

    N_total_fdmn,
    N_total_fdmn,

    N_deaths,
    N_deaths,

    deaths_u5,
    deaths_u5,

    N_vaccinated,
    N_vaccinated,

    N_total - N_vaccinated,

    fdmn,
    host,

    sam$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition,
    mam$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition
  ),

  Denominator = c(
    N_total,
    N_total,
    N_total,

    N_total,
    N_total,
    N_total,

    pop_at_risk,
    pop_at_risk * surv_days,
#Deaths
    NA,
    N_total,
#Deaths under 5
    N_cases_u5,
    N_cases_u5,

    NA,
    N_total,

    N_total,

    N_total,
    N_total,

    sam$total,
    mam$total
  ),

  `Rate / %` = c(
    round(N_discharge / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_LAMA / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_deaths / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(N_JMS / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(O_JMS / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(N_HMS / N_total * 100, 1),

    attack_rate,
    incidence_rate,

    NA,
    cfr,

    NA,
    cfr_u5,

    NA,
    vacc_coverage,

    round((N_total - N_vaccinated) / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(fdmn / N_total * 100, 1),
    round(host / N_total * 100, 1),

    round(
      sam$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition / sam$total * 100, 1
    ),
    round(
      mam$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition / mam$total * 100, 1
    )
  )
)


surveillance_overview_clean <- surveillance_overview %>%
  filter(
    !Indicator %in% c(
      "Severe cases - N",
      "Severe rate (%)"
    )
  )

surveillance_overview_final <- bind_rows(
  add_section("CLINICAL OUTCOMES"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(1:3),

  add_section("CASE CLASSIFICATION"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(4:6),

  add_section("POPULATION & INCIDENCE"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(7:9),

  add_section("MORTALITY"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(10:13),

  add_section("VACCINATION STATUS"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(14:16),

  add_section("NATIONALITY"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(16:17),

  add_section("NUTRITION STATUS (<5 YEARS)"),
  surveillance_overview_clean %>% slice(18:n())
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create a formatted flextable (SECTION 1 style)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

N_total_fdmn <- measles_data %>%
  filter(nationality == "fdmn") %>%
  nrow()
attack_rate <- round(N_total_fdmn / pop_at_risk * 1000, 2)

surveillance_gt <- surveillance_overview_final %>%
  gt() %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # TABLE HEADER (blue background, white text)
  # -------------------------------------------------
  tab_header(
    title = md("**SURVEILLANCE INDICATORS**")
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # COLUMN LABELS (blue text on white background)
  # -------------------------------------------------
  cols_label(
    Indicator   = "Indicator",
    N           = "N",
    Denominator = "Denominator",
    `Rate / %`  = "%"
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Alignment
  # -------------------------------------------------
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c("N", "Denominator", "Rate / %")
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = "Indicator"
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Number formatting
  # -------------------------------------------------
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c("N", "Denominator"),
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = "Rate / %",
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  fmt_missing(
    columns = c("N", "Denominator", "Rate / %"),
    missing_text = ""
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # HEADER STYLING
  # -------------------------------------------------

  # Blue background + white text for table title
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  # Blue text for column headers
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Section headers (rows created by add_section)
  # -------------------------------------------------
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = is.na(`N`))
  ) %>%

  # -------------------------------------------------
  # Body text
  # -------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
#| title: "Isolation ward"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

ipd <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "IPD")

N_IPD <- nrow(ipd)


parse_los_minutes <- function(x) {
  hrs <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+(?=\\s*hours?)"))
  mins <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "\\d+(?=\\s*minutes?)"))

  hrs[is.na(hrs)] <- 0
  mins[is.na(mins)] <- 0

  hrs * 60 + mins
}

ipd <- ipd %>%
  mutate(
    los_minutes = parse_los_minutes(los_final)
  )
total_los_days <- sum(ipd$los_minutes, na.rm = TRUE) / 60 / 24
avg_los_days <- total_los_days / N_IPD

indicator_tbl <- tibble::tibble(

  Indicator = c(
    "Total admissions (IPD)",
    "— From referral (facility)",
    "— Own catchment (self/walk-in)",
    "% Children <5 years",
    "% Unvaccinated",
    "% With pneumonia (any)",
    "— Severe pneumonia",
    "— Simple pneumonia",
    "% With SAM or MAM",
    "— SAM only",
    "— MAM only",
    "% Vitamin A given (within 24h)"
  ),

  Numerator = c(
    N_IPD,
    sum(!is.na(ipd$referral_from) & !ipd$referral_from %in% c("n/a", "n_a", "")),
    sum(is.na(ipd$referral_from) | ipd$referral_from %in% c("n/a", "n_a", "")),
    sum(ipd$age_in_years < 5, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(ipd$did_the_patient_receive_measle == "no", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(
  ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_pneumonia == "TRUE" |
  ipd$final_diagnoses_simple_pneumonia == "TRUE",
  na.rm = TRUE
),
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_pneumonia == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_simple_pneumonia == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),

    # ✅ SAM OR MAM (either diagnosis)
    sum(
      ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition == "TRUE" |
      ipd$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition == "TRUE",
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # ✅ SAM only
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_severe_acute_malnutrition == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),

    # ✅ MAM only
    sum(ipd$final_diagnoses_moderate_acute_malnutrition == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE),

    sum(ipd$did_the_patient_receive_vitamin_a == "yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  ),

  Denominator = c(
    N_IPD,

    N_IPD,
    N_IPD,
    N_IPD,
    N_IPD,
    N_IPD,
    N_IPD,
    N_IPD
  )
) %>%

    `Rate / %` = round(Numerator / Denominator * 100, 2),
```

```{r second tab}
#| title: "Age groups"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%

# define age groups

measles_data_age <- measles_data |>
  mutate(
    age_in_months = as.integer(age_in_months),
    age_group = case_when(
      age_in_years == 0 & age_in_months < 9  ~ "<9 months",
      age_in_years == 0 & age_in_months >= 9 ~ "9 months–4 years",
      age_in_years >= 1 & age_in_years < 5   ~ "9 months–4 years",
      age_in_years >= 5 & age_in_years < 15  ~ "5–14 years",
      age_in_years >= 15                     ~ "≥15 years",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ))

age_prop <- measles_data_age |>
  count(age_group) |>
  rename(N_all = n)

# Severe IPD cases by age group
age_severe_ipd <- measles_data_age |>
  filter(
    does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes",
    clinical_severity == "severe"
  ) |>
  count(age_group, name = "Severe_IPD_N")

# ---------- Prepare OPD age distribution ----------
age_prop_opd <- measles_data_age |>
  filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and %in% c("no", "n/a")) |>
  count(age_group, name = "OPD_N")

# ---------- Prepare IPD age distribution (reuse logic) ----------
age_prop_ipd_full <- measles_data_age |>
  filter(does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes") |>
  count(age_group, name = "IPD_N")

# ---------- Combine ALL / OPD / IPD ----------

age_section2 <- age_prop |>
  left_join(age_prop_opd, by = "age_group") |>
  left_join(age_prop_ipd_full, by = "age_group") |>
  mutate(
    OPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(OPD_N, 0),
    IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(IPD_N, 0),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total`   = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2)
  )


age_levels <- c(
  "<9 months",
  "9 months–4 years",
  "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
  "5–14 years",
  "≥15 years"
)

# ---------- UNDER‑5 TOTAL row ----------
under5_row <- age_section2 |>
  filter(age_group %in% c("<9 months", "9 months–4 years")) |>
  summarise(
    age_group   = "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    N_all       = sum(N_all),
    Denominator = N_total,
    `% Total`   = round(N_all / N_total * 100, 2),
    OPD_N       = sum(OPD_N),
    IPD_N       = sum(IPD_N)
  )

# ---- UNDER‑5 Severe IPD row (THIS IS THE FIX) ----
severe_under5_row <- measles_data_age |>
  filter(
    does_this_patient_admitted_and == "yes",
    clinical_severity == "severe",
    age_group %in% c("<9 months", "9 months–4 years")
  ) |>
  summarise(
    age_group    = "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
    Severe_IPD_N = n()
  )

# ---- Combine age‑specific + UNDER‑5 Severe IPD ----
age_severe_ipd_final <- bind_rows(
  age_severe_ipd,
  severe_under5_row
)


# ---- Final table with Severe IPD and % ----
age_section2_final <- bind_rows(age_section2, under5_row) |>
  left_join(age_severe_ipd_final, by = "age_group") |>
  mutate(
    Severe_IPD_N = tidyr::replace_na(Severe_IPD_N, 0),
    `% of IPD`   = round(IPD_N / N_IPD * 100, 2),
    `Severe %`   = round(
      ifelse(IPD_N > 0, Severe_IPD_N / IPD_N * 100, NA),
      2
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = age_levels)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    age_group,
    N_all,
    Denominator,
    `% Total`,
    OPD_N,
    IPD_N,
    `% of IPD`,
    Severe_IPD_N,
    `Severe %`
  )


age_levels <- c(
  "<9 months",

  "UNDER 5 TOTAL (<5 years)",
  "5–14 years",
  "≥15 years"
)

age_section2_final <- age_section2_final %>%

age_gt <- age_section2_final %>%
```

```{r third tab}
#| title: "Patient Origin"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0

library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Standardise camp names
# --------------------------------------------------

measles_camp <- measles_data %>%
  mutate(
    Camp = case_when(
      camp %in% c("14", "Camp 14") ~ "Camp 14",
      camp %in% c("15", "Camp 15") ~ "Camp 15",
      camp %in% c("16", "Camp 16") ~ "Camp 16",
      TRUE                         ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Case counts by camp (ALL cases)
# --------------------------------------------------

camp_cases <- measles_camp %>%
  group_by(Camp) %>%
  summarise(
    `ALL Cases` = n(),
    IPD_N       = sum(ipd_opd == "IPD", na.rm = TRUE),
    Simple_N    = sum(clinical_severity == "simple", na.rm = TRUE),
    Severe_N    = sum(clinical_severity == "severe", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Camp population (for attack rate)
# --------------------------------------------------

camp_population_clean <- camp_population %>%
  mutate(
    Camp = case_when(
      `Camp / Location` %in% c("Camp 14", "Camp 15", "Camp 16") ~ `Camp / Location`,
      TRUE                                                     ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Camp) %>%
  summarise(
    Population = sum(`Pop (At Risk)`),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Final table data (NO IPD SUBSECTION)
# --------------------------------------------------

camp_table <- camp_cases %>%
  left_join(camp_population_clean, by = "Camp") %>%
  mutate(
    `% Total` = round(`ALL Cases` / sum(`ALL Cases`) * 100, 1),
    `Attack Rate /1k` = round((`ALL Cases` / Population) * 1000, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Camp, levels = c("Camp 14", "Camp 15", "Camp 16", "Other"))) %>%
  transmute(
    Camp,
    `ALL Cases`,
    `% Total`,
    IPD_N,
    Simple_N,
    Severe_N,
    `Attack Rate /1k`
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# GT table rendering
# --------------------------------------------------

camp_gt <- camp_table %>%
  gt() %>%

  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patients Origin by Camp**")
  ) %>%

  cols_label(
    Camp              = "Camp / Location",
    `ALL Cases`       = "All Cases",
    `% Total`         = "% Total",
    IPD_N             = "IPD (N)",
    Simple_N          = "Simple (N)",
    Severe_N          = "Severe (N)",
    `Attack Rate /1k` = "Attack Rate /1k"
  ) %>%

  cols_align("left", Camp) %>%
  cols_align(
    "right",
    c(`ALL Cases`, `% Total`, IPD_N, Simple_N, Severe_N, `Attack Rate /1k`)
  ) %>%

  opt_table_font(
    font = list(google_font("Roboto"), default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  # Title bar
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  # Column headers
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%

  # Body text
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%

  cols_width(
    Camp ~ px(230),
    everything() ~ px(120)
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "Co-diagnoses"
#| fig.asp: 1
#| out.width: 100%
#| fig.align: center
#| fig.margin: 0
N_IPD <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  nrow()

N_all <- nrow(measles_data)

N_complicated_ipd <- measles_data %>%
  filter(
    ipd_opd == "IPD",
    clinical_severity == "severe"
  ) %>%
  nrow()


final_dx_long <- measles_data %>%
  filter(ipd_opd == "IPD") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    starts_with("final_diagnoses_"),
    -any_of("final_diagnoses_measles")   # ✅ safe whether it exists or not
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ .x == "TRUE") # character → logical
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to  = "Diagnosis",
    values_to = "Present"
  ) %>%
  filter(Present)


co_dx_table <- final_dx_long %>%
  count(Diagnosis, name = "Numerator") %>%
  mutate(
    `Denominator (IPD)`        = N_IPD,
    `% of IPD Admissions`      = round(Numerator / N_IPD * 100, 2),
    `% of All Cases`           = round(Numerator / N_all * 100, 2)
  )

co_dx_complicated <- final_dx_long %>%
  inner_join(
    measles_data %>%
      filter(ipd_opd == "IPD", clinical_severity == "severe") %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      dplyr::select(id),
    by = character()
  ) %>%
  count(Diagnosis, name = "Complicated_N") %>%
  mutate(
    `% of Complicated IPD` =
      round(Complicated_N / N_complicated_ipd * 100, 2)
  )

co_dx_final <- co_dx_table %>%
  left_join(co_dx_complicated, by = "Diagnosis") %>%
  mutate(
    Diagnosis = gsub("final_diagnoses_", "+ ", Diagnosis),
    Diagnosis = gsub("_", " ", Diagnosis),
    Diagnosis = tools::toTitleCase(Diagnosis)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Numerator))


library(gt)

co_dx_gt <- co_dx_final %>%
  gt() %>%

  tab_header(
    title = md("**Co-Diagnoses IPD patients**")
  ) %>%

  cols_label(
    Diagnosis               = "Co-Diagnosis",
    Numerator               = "N (IPD)",
    `Denominator (IPD)`     = "Total IPD",
    `% of IPD Admissions`   = "% of IPD",
    `% of All Cases`        = "% of All Cases",
    `% of Complicated IPD`  = "% of Complicated IPD"
  ) %>%

  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Diagnosis) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Diagnosis) %>%

  opt_table_font(
    font = list(google_font("Roboto"), default_fonts())
  ) %>%
  opt_align_table_header(align = "left") %>%

  # Title bar
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#008CBA"),
      cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%

  # Column headers
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "#008CBA", weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%

  # Body text
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(color = "black"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%

  cols_width(
    Diagnosis ~ px(260),
    everything() ~ px(130)
  )
```
